history.note: needs missing engine capability: effect execution cannot suspend mid-sequence. handle_optional auto-applies because there is no continuation mechanism - handle_sequence/for-each are unaware of draft.pendingChoice, so a yes/no raised inside the for-each would drop the remaining iterations and the 'Then buff all friendly units' step. Real fix = resolve-time confirm prompt carrying the whole sequence + boundTargets support in spend-buff (5 shared files, changes every card whose sequence starts with an optional step).
